gaps: **Two dates for the way into South Africa.** The family's account here has Johannesburg from about 1970. [The Blažević Archive](https://blazevic.defranceski.com/hedviga/) has Ivan's mother, Hedviga, arriving in South Africa from Zimbabwe in April 1975. The two have not been reconciled, and neither rests on a document in this archive.
ivan-defranceski-1951.loreDek: These are the family's accounts of Ivan's parents, Ivan and Hedviga, and how they came to leave. Each is lore until a record says otherwise; they are set down as they were told, beside what this archive can put against them.
